solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A dour bent shown by American tough

indicators.note: bent means twisted out of shape, so the letters of a dour are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sour-faced American comes across as hard and unyielding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bent' looks like an adjective for the dour person's leaning, but it is the signal to rearrange A DOUR; 'shown by' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An arduous task is a hard, demanding one, so tough is a synonym.

clue.text: Believe one wouldn't say no to this

definitions.meaning: to ... a claim is to believe it

definitions.text: one wouldn't say no to this
definitions.meaning: to take up an offer is not to refuse it

explanation.surface: Someone trusts what is said and would never refuse it.
explanation.definitionFit: To believe a story is to take it as true, and to take up an offer is not to refuse it.

clue.text: Draw in new capital

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh form, so the letters of draw in are rearranged

explanation.surface: Attract a fresh source of funds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money but is the city: DARWIN is capital of Australia's Northern Territory.
explanation.definitionFit: Darwin is the capital city of the Northern Territory in Australia.

clue.text: Fails to turn out as intended

definitions.text: Fails to turn out as intended

parts.words: Fails to turn out as intended
parts.note: turn out here means get out of bed, which someone who stays asleep too long fails to do on time

explanation.surface: A plan that does not go as expected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn out' reads as 'result', but it means rise from bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sleeping past their alarm does not get up at the time they meant to.

clue.text: Share the port

definitions.meaning: A port on the Croatian coast

explanation.surface: Divide out the fortified wine.
explanation.definitionFit: To split is to share out, and Split is a Croatian port on the Adriatic.

clue.text: Kind of crossing made by Drake's ship

definitions.meaning: a light-controlled pedestrian road crossing in Britain is named after this bird
Francis Drake's ship was first named after this bird before being renamed the Golden Hind

explanation.surface: A naval voyage across the sea by Sir Francis Drake's vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: A PELICAN crossing is a British pedestrian crossing with push-button traffic lights; Drake sailed round the world in the Pelican, later renamed the Golden Hind.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are proper names: a British style of pedestrian crossing and the original name of Drake's flagship.

clue.text: Plucky action taken by some of the players

definitions.text: Plucky action taken by some of the players

parts.words: Plucky action taken by some of the players
parts.note: plucky refers to plucking strings, done by string players in an orchestra

explanation.surface: Some team members make a brave move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plucky' means brave on the surface but here means plucking strings.
explanation.definitionFit: Pizzicato is a musical direction to pluck the strings rather than bow them.

clue.text: It makes a pass into a path

definitions.text: It makes a pass into a path

parts.words: It makes a pass into a path
parts.note: a speech defect pronouncing s as th turns the word pass into the word path

explanation.surface: Something turns a mountain pass into a footpath.
explanation.walkthrough: Say 'pass' with an S sounded as TH and it comes out as 'path'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lisp is a speech impediment where s and z are sounded as th.

clue.text: Car is not damaged, being strong

indicators.note: damaged means broken up, so the letters of car is not are rearranged

explanation.surface: A car escapes harm because it is robust.
explanation.definitionFit: Cast-iron, figuratively, means very firm or strong, like an unbreakable guarantee.

clue.text: Score but one

parts.note: a score is twenty, and but one means less one

explanation.surface: A team scores only a single goal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Score' is twenty, not a goal; 'but one' means all but one.
explanation.definitionFit: Twenty minus one gives the number one short of a score.

clue.text: About five get better in turn

indicators.note: about here means placed around, so the word for get better encloses the numeral

parts.note: to cure is to make better, restore to health
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Roughly five patients recover one after another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' looks like 'approximately' but is the container signal; 'in turn' hides the definition 'turn' after the link 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A curve is a bend or turn in a road or line.

clue.text: Idle girl that goes round giving choice to consumers

definitions.text: that goes round giving choice to consumers

parts.note: idle means lazy, not inclined to work
Susan is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A lazy young woman wanders about offering diners options.
explanation.walkthrough: A LAZY SUSAN is a revolving tray on a dining table, letting diners pick from the dishes on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A revolving serving tray spins so that eaters can choose from the dishes on it.

clue.text: Plant in peat, so it develops

indicators.note: develops suggests something growing into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plant growing in peat soil as it develops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'develops' rearranges the ten letters of IN PEAT SO IT.
explanation.definitionFit: The poinsettia is a Mexican plant with red bracts, popular at Christmas.

clue.text: Brand new money-making concern

definitions.meaning: in ... condition means as good as new, unused
the Royal ... is the place where coins are made

explanation.surface: A brand-new business that makes its owners rich.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: pristine condition, and the establishment that literally manufactures money.

clue.text: The British TT?

parts.note: the Isle of Man TT is a motorcycle race on an island, and the British are called an island people

explanation.surface: Asks what the famous British motorbike race is.
explanation.walkthrough: The TT (Tourist Trophy) is a motorcycle race on the Isle of Man; the British are often called an island race, i.e. people.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both a race held on an island and the British as an island people.

clue.text: Isn't it particular what it sells?

definitions.text: Isn't it particular what it sells?

parts.words: Isn't it particular what it sells?
parts.note: particular is played against general: a shop selling everything is not particular, i.e. not specialised

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a shop is fussy about its stock.
explanation.walkthrough: A GENERAL STORE sells a wide range of goods; general being the opposite of particular gives the joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop with general rather than particular stock carries all sorts of everyday goods.

clue.text: Financial expert comes into new organisation

indicators.note: a new organisation of letters means comes into is rearranged

explanation.surface: A money specialist joins a newly formed company.
explanation.definitionFit: An economist is a specialist in the economy and its finances.

clue.text: It's to do with pursuit of game, naturally

definitions.text: It's to do with pursuit of game
definitions.meaning: coursing is hunting hares with dogs
naturally means certainly, as might be expected

explanation.surface: Of course hunting is involved, as you would expect.
explanation.walkthrough: Coursing is the sport of chasing hares with greyhounds.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a stock way of saying certainly or as expected.

clue.text: Note about illustrious French city

parts.note: G is a musical note
re means about, concerning
noble means illustrious, distinguished

explanation.surface: A note concerning a distinguished city in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenoble is a city in the French Alps.

clue.text: Company offer definitive vote for union?

parts.note: a firm is a business company
a proposal is an offer put forward

explanation.surface: A business makes a bid, seeking a decisive ballot in favour of a merger.
explanation.walkthrough: The union is marriage: a firm proposal is a definite offer, here of marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm offer is definite, and proposing is the classic request for marital union.

clue.text: Lure damaged net on the rocks

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of net are broken up into a new order

parts.note: a drink on the rocks is served with ice

explanation.surface: A fishing net torn on the rocks tempts fish in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges NET into ENT; 'on the rocks' sounds like shipwreck but means with ice.
explanation.definitionFit: To entice is to lure or tempt someone.

clue.text: Numbers playing in Rugby competitions, perhaps

definitions.meaning: the figure seven written in the plural names numbers
rugby ... is a seven-a-side tournament game

explanation.surface: How many people take part in rugby tournaments.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby sevens is a short form of rugby union with seven players a side.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a plural of a number and the name of seven-a-side rugby contests.

clue.text: The sound of a pig at home in agreeable surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings means the word for agreeable is placed around the word for at home

parts.note: OK means acceptable, agreeable
in means at home, as in 'staying in'

explanation.surface: A pig grunting happily at home in pleasant surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: Oink is the conventional imitation of a pig's grunt.

clue.text: Shared secret belief

definitions.meaning: a secret told privately to someone
firm trust or faith in something

explanation.surface: A secret held in common turns into a conviction.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: something told in private trust, and assured faith or trust.

clue.text: Foil … for trespassers?

definitions.meaning: to foil and to ... both suggest swordplay; a foil is a fencing sword

explanation.surface: Something to thwart people intruding on land.
explanation.walkthrough: A foil is the light sword used in fencing.
explanation.definitionFit: A foil is a fencing weapon, and a barrier keeps intruders off property.

clue.text: Be a shade over-extravagant?

parts.note: a shade is a colour, and to squander money recklessly is a British slang sense of the colour word

explanation.surface: Asks whether someone is a little too lavish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a shade' reads as 'slightly', but it means a colour; in British slang to blue money is to squander it.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a colour and, as slang, means to spend money wastefully.

clue.text: Defiant beast, rising

parts.note: a rebel is a defiant person
a lion is a beast

explanation.surface: A defiant animal gets up on its hind legs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' looks like an indicator turning the beast upward, but it is the definition: a rising is a revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A rising, or uprising, is an armed revolt against authority.

clue.text: Come up with more money

definitions.meaning: to come up is to get up or emerge
read as two words, a rise is an increase in pay

explanation.surface: Someone appears and offers extra cash.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the answer as A RISE, British for a pay increase.
explanation.definitionFit: To arise is to emerge or appear, and a pay rise brings more money.

clue.text: Peak time before break

parts.note: the eve is the time just before an event, as Christmas Eve
a rest is a break from work

explanation.surface: It is time to stop before a pause in climbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before' looks like a placement signal, but 'time before' together gives EVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Everest is the world's highest mountain peak.

clue.text: Level betting includes the French teams

indicators.note: includes means the betting term holds the French article within it

parts.note: evens are betting odds of one to one, level money
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Even-money odds are offered on French sides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Level' reads as flat or even-tempered, but 'Level betting' is the bookmaker's even-money odds.
explanation.definitionFit: An eleven is a side in football or cricket, so elevens are teams.
